title: Wolfsmund
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Early 14th-century Alps: the Habsburg bailiff Wolfram guards Wolfsmund, the fortress checkpoint on the St. Gotthard Pass, and interrogates everyone who tries to cross (ANN blurb via AniList; MangaUpdates). Rebels of the Forest Cantons, helped by the innkeeper Grete's secret route, try again and again to get through and usually die in the attempt; William Tell later appears (UK Anime Network review). An eight-volume seinen historical tragedy.
life_message: It holds up resistance to tyranny and the hope of freedom as worth suffering and dying for.

content.note: Beheadings, lashings, drownings and mutilated bodies (UK Anime Network); MangaUpdates Torture, Brutality, Execution, Blood and Gore; AniList Gore.
Near-constant dread at the checkpoint; most travelers die (blurbs; review); Tragedy tags.
Frequent sex scenes and nudity, plus sexual violence (review); MangaUpdates Sexual Abuse, Child Rape, Prostitution. Abuse of a child is shown as atrocity, not titillation (to verify).
Grief and despair among rebels; MangaUpdates Nihilism.
Torture shown as cruelty of the occupier.

dominant: Liberty against occupation, the cost of resistance, tyranny critiqued

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Life is about surviving the Maw; most do not (blurbs).

folkways.japan: A Japanese author retelling the Swiss founding legend through the seinen 'cruel tragedy' tradition, with stoic endurance and self-sacrifice that Japanese readers prize.

delivery.evidence: Reviewer calls it a 'straightforward rebels-against-the-evil-empire affair', sometimes 'almost stupidly overcooked'.
delivery.note: The occupier's side is shown through a cruel but clever bailiff; the reviewer finds him less clever than the story claims.

winners_losers: Most rebels and travelers die at the Maw; the cantons' cause of liberty gets the story's sympathy, and the Habsburg occupation is cast as cruel.
to_verify: Child Rape tag (MangaUpdates) and the nude child torture scene (review): check whether abuse is shown and how it is framed.
